stem_book: The ionic bonds X⁺Y⁻ are formed when : (I) electron affinity of Y is high (II) ionization energy of X is low (III) lattice energy of XY is high (IV) lattice energy of XY is low. Choose the correct code : (a) I and II (b) I and III (c) I, II and III (d) All of these
work: ionic bond favoured by low IE(X), high EA(Y), high lattice energy → I, II, III
